description: Fetches news articles and press releases from the IUPAC archive (old.iupac.org), handling legacy table-based HTML layouts.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_article: 获取并解析单篇新闻文章; 需要参数 url; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_archive_listing: 获取归档索引页面的文章链接列表; 需要参数 url; 参数: url; 必填: url

url.description:
要获取的页面完整URL。例如:
  - https://old.iupac.org/news/archives/2003/naming110.html
  - https://old.iupac.org/news/archives.html
  - https://old.iupac.org/news/archives-notes.html
